node: Housing repair, remodel, rental turnover, and replacement-cycle suppliers
summary: Layer 1B expanded the node with one reference anchor and three small/mid-cap discovery candidates. The reference lane is Home Depot because it frames end-market demand from residential repair, remodel, maintenance, professional contractors, and acquired specialty distribution assets. The underfollowed lane emphasizes companies whose exposure is one step away from the obvious retailer: cabinets with big-box customer concentration, pool-equipment aftermarket replacement, and landscape-materials distribution serving maintenance plus repair/upgrade work. No buy/sell view is implied; all candidates need later-layer verification of replacement mix, contractor channel durability, pricing power, tariff exposure, and cyclicality.
